checks.text: The page heading is "Certificate Generator" and the default view shows a form with fields labelled "Recipient name", "Course title", "Date", and "Issuer".

Typing "Alice Smith" in the field labelled "Recipient name", "Web Development" in the field labelled "Course title", "2023-10-15" in the field labelled "Date", and "Acme Corp" in the field labelled "Issuer", then clicking the button "Generate PDF" creates a certificate entry in the "Generated Certificates" list with the text "Alice Smith - Web Development".
After generating a certificate for "Alice Smith", clicking the button "Download PDF" next to that entry triggers a file download named "Alice_Smith_Web_Development.pdf".

Clicking the tab labelled "History" shows a table with columns "Recipient", "Course", "Date", and "Issuer". The table contains a row with "Alice Smith", "Web Development", "2023-10-15", and "Acme Corp".
In the "History" tab, clicking the button "Delete" next to the row for "Alice Smith" removes that row from the table, and the table shows the text "No certificates yet".

Typing an empty string in the field labelled "Recipient name" and clicking "Generate PDF" shows the message "Recipient name is required" and does not add a new entry to the "Generated Certificates" list.
After generating a certificate for "Bob Jones" with Course "Data Science", the "Generated Certificates" list contains two items: "Alice Smith - Web Development" and "Bob Jones - Data Science".
In the "History" tab, the table shows two rows: one for "Alice Smith" and one for "Bob Jones", each with their respective course, date, and issuer details.
Reload keeps the certificate for "Alice Smith" in the "History" tab, with the row showing "Alice Smith", "Web Development", "2023-10-15", and "Acme Corp".
